title: Microparkt standup capture — week of 2026-07-13
body:
Context and goals:
This note is a quick weekly capture for the Microparkt experiment pod. Primary focus: safe model onboarding of 3B/7B variants, mixed-bit quantization probes (3/4-bit hybrid paths), and lightweight eval harnesses that run in CI. Use this to sync across the small cross-functional group and preserve transient troubleshooting notes.

Summary (1-2 lines):
- Progress was steady: baseline throughput for 7B fp16 validated on the local dev rig; 4-bit hybrid quant gives ~1.9x inference speedup with an observed 1.7% drop on the internal instruct-scoring eval.
- Main blocker: intermittent token-level hallucination spikes on /generate when kv-prefetch enabled + 3-bit weight folding.

This week's highlights:
- Hybrid quant path (layerwise mix of 3/4-bit using stochastic rounding) landed in the prototype runtime (PR linked above). Initial microbench on p4d-small shows 45% latency reduction at batch=1 for prompt length 64 compared to fp16 runtime.
- Small-scale eval harness (micro-eval-lite) integrated into CI. Runs 200 prompt pairs (instructions + references) overnight and reports BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxy + answer type classification.
- Onboarding checklist drafted for the 3B model: model card + tokenizer checks + perf baseline + safety probe bundle. Confluence page stub created.

Experiment log (technical details):
- Setup: dev rig (single A10G), runtime branch microparkt-quant-experiments. Model: redwood-7b-v2 (fp16 baseline). Quant: per-channel symmetric 3-bit for most FFN weights + 4-bit for attention QKV. KV cache prefetch toggled on/off.
- Microbench numbers (median of 50 runs):
  - fp16 baseline: 1.0x latency, 100% token accuracy (internal metric), 0.0% regressions
  - 4-bit hybrid: 0.53x latency, 0.9% drop on instruct-score, single-run variance +0.8%
  - 3/4 hybrid (stochastic rounding): 0.48x latency, 1.7% drop on instruct-score, hallucination spikes observed in ~2% of runs when kv-prefetch=on
- Notes on observation: hallucination pattern seems tied to prompt templates that include few-shot examples with non-standard delimiters. Hypothesis: quantized KV interpolation causes misaligned attention logits for long prefix contexts.

Evals and QA:
- micro-eval-lite outcomes: passes basic consistency checks (tokenizer mismatch, missing special tokens) early but flags ~35 prompts for semantic drift. Manual triage needed.
- We added a lightweight rollback test: serve 50 quantized responses and compare to baseline using a soft-fidelity score (token overlap + semantic cosine threshold). If fidelity < 0.88, fail. Current 3/4 hybrid average = 0.915 but variance high.
- Action: add targeted evals that stress few-shot delimiter scenarios and named-entity continuity. Assign: Ethan. Deadline: 2026-07-17.

Onboarding runbook (draft items):
- Checklist items completed: model artifact validation (sha256), tokenizer spec check, model config parity, baseline fp16 perf measurement.
- Pending: privacy-scan on training corpus references (Maria doing), safety-regression eval (use safety probe bundle), CI rollout gating (feature flag + canary).
- Early-canary plan: 1% traffic on dedicated pool, 24h metrics watch (latency, error-rate, fidelity). Contingencies: auto-fallback to fp16 if fidelity drop > 3% or 95th latency > +40% over baseline.

Blockers / unknowns:
- Blocker A: KV prefetch combined with 3-bit weight folding yields token-level misalignment in ~2% of long-prefix prompts. Repro steps inconsistent; sometimes trigger only after many incremental edits to prompt. Need better deterministic repro harness.
- Blocker B: micro-eval-lite latency on CI runners spikes due to VM cold-starts; end-to-end nightly takes 2.5x longer than local dev. Might need container warmup or dedicated runner.
- Unknown: does stochastic rounding interact badly with fused attention kernels on Ampere? Hypothesis: FP32 accumulation variance crossing threshold causing softmax scale drift. Requires kernel-level trace.

Decisions made this week:
- Pause broad rollout of 3-bit folding until we have deterministic repro for KV-prefetch bug. Continue offline exploration and narrow down failing layers.
- Promote 4-bit hybrid as the default experimental profile for canary (better latency/quality tradeoff currently).

Action items (owner — due):
- Ethan Lee — design targeted delimiter & few-shot eval set; add to micro-eval-lite (2026-07-17)
- Maria Gonzalez — run privacy-scan on model artifact and report flagged references (2026-07-16)
- Alexei Petrov — add deterministic replay harness that can re-run failed token sequences and capture intermediate logits/KV snapshots (2026-07-20)
- Priya Raman — update canary playbook with fallback thresholds and monitoring dashboards (2026-07-18)

Notes to self / misc fragments:
- Slack snippets: #applied-ml-microparkt — pinned message about PR87 review comments.
- Reminder: check REINF-3421 for infra autoscaler noise; it may be contributing to CI flakiness.
- Quick patch idea: temporally disable kv-prefetch in the runtime for quantized sessions and measure fidelity delta; useful as a quick mitigation for canary.

Open questions for PM review:
- Do we want to ship 4-bit hybrid to Dedicated as an opt-in perf tier for customers willing to accept small fidelity risk? Need pricing/SLAs discussion.
- How aggressive should automatic fallback be on short-lived fidelity drops? (some customers accept transient quality variance).

Appendix (short troubleshooting log):
- 2026-07-12 10:32 — first hallucination cluster observed while testing TEMPLATE-17 (few-shot email rewrite).
- 2026-07-12 14:05 — repro attempt failed on repeated reruns; only reproduced after slight tokenization change.
- 2026-07-13 09:20 — Alexei captured intermediate KV dump; large spike in attention Q norm prior to divergence.

If you read nothing else: favor 4-bit hybrid for canary, build deterministic repro for the kv-prefetch + 3-bit bug, and add delimiter-focused evals to the micro-eval-lite harness.

-- Priya
